tools.name: create_poll_draft
tools.description: Create a poll draft (1-100 single-choice questions, 2-10 options each). Returns id, token, version and edit_url. Give the edit_url to the person so they can review, verify and publish it in their browser; the draft expires 24 hours after creation. Never say the poll is published.

tools.name: get_poll_draft
tools.description: Read the latest content and version of a draft. Call this before every update: the person may have edited the draft in the browser.

tools.name: update_poll_draft
tools.description: Replace the whole draft content. Send the version you just read with get_poll_draft. On version_conflict, read the draft again and re-apply your change; never overwrite newer content with an older copy.
